card.name: Start of eye-related words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word about the eye, such as oc- in ocular, E- in EYE, o- in ophthalmologist, or the start of periocular terms. It fires where the next piece will finish an eye term.

card.plain: It fires on the first letters of eye words like ocular, eye and ophthalmologist.
